mentions.name: SocialProof
mentions.description: SocialProof is a testimonial collection tool for freelancers and small agencies. A single shareable link lets clients submit a short written testimonial (name, text, optional photo) without any login; the freelancer approves submissions and embeds approved testimonials anywhere on their site. The whole product runs on Cloudflare Workers, D1, and Pages, with the collection form and embed widget edge-served globally and no origin server. Launched today and still pre-revenue.
mentions.problem: Freelancers have happy clients but almost no testimonials on their sites — asking is awkward, clients say "sure!" and then never write anything.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building SocialProof (socialproof.dev) — the simplest way for freelancers and small agencies to collect written testimonials from clients.

mentions.name: SocialProof
mentions.description: This tool helps service businesses collect written testimonials from happy clients via a shareable link. Instead of a blank review box, it guides clients through structured questions (e.g. "what was your situation before?" / "what changed?") so the business gets a compelling before/after narrative automatically. It offers a free tier with unlimited testimonials.
mentions.problem: Getting testimonials is hard because a blank "leave a review" box produces mediocre one-liners, even from clients who want to help.
mentions.audience: Service businesses and anyone who deals with collecting client testimonials.
